case: sidebar AgentTeams/Workmates panels INVISIBLE in the live GUI — root cause, fix, and live-browser proof
supersedes: the earlier result-parity-round.json in this directory, which recorded the visual-parity work but NOT the fact that the tabs never registered at all in the live GUI
userReport: 目前我是完全看不见面板，都别说测试了 — the sidebar shows no AgentTeams/Workmates panel at all
tree: branch dev, uncommitted working tree; hashes.txt describes exactly this revision

rootCause.symptom: Live GUI (127.0.0.1:3080): the better-sidebar `+` menu offered only Files / Changes / Tasks / Side Chat (beta) / Terminal / Browser, and the console carried two warnings of our own: `[mpd] better-sidebar not installed — the AgentTeams page has no host` and the same for `the workmate library has no host`.
rootCause.why: packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/web-client.js probed `ctx.get('betterSidebar')` ONCE during apply() and gave up. DSH-better-sidebar publishes that service from its OWN plugin fiber, which activates later than our entry, and cordis resolves services through the fiber scope and only re-evaluates fibers that DECLARE the dependency — so the probe can never see it and can never be retried.
evidence: playwright against the LIVE GUI: after expanding the panel, the `+` menu had no mpd row; console showed our two 'not installed' warnings while dsh-better-sidebar's own UI (Expand sidebar toggle, Files tab, nArs4W_* classes) was demonstrably rendering in the SAME page

temporary journaled diagnostic in the shipped client: `[mpd-diag] apply: ctx.get(betterSidebar)=false ctx.betterSidebar=THREW: cannot get property "betterSidebar" without inject` ... `[mpd-diag] +8s: ctx.get(betterSidebar)=true typeof=object` — the service EXISTS, it simply is not there YET

cordis source (@deepseek-ai/cordis/src): `reflect.get` -> `const key = this.ctx[symbols.isolate][name]`; `provide()` does `this.ctx.root[symbols.isolate][name] ??= Symbol(name)`; `notify()` skips any fiber where `!(name in fiber.inject)`
boot graph of the live server: entry `@mpd-dsh/mpd` present, `dsh-better-sidebar` present and ACTIVE
rootCause.note: The 'no fallback by design' warning text was actively misleading: the sidebar WAS installed. The probe was refused, not the installation absent.

fix.packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/web-clien: `mountSidebarPages(ctx, teamPage)` registers both pages from `ctx.inject(['betterSidebar'], (sidebarCtx) => ...)` — the runtime's own pattern for a service that mounts asynchronously (better-sidebar uses exactly this for its `remote.session`). It waits for the provider, re-runs after a provider remount, and never parks this entry, so a profile without the sidebar simply never fires the callback instead of becoming a fatal `pending` row. The old `serviceAvailable` probe helper and the `PROBED_SERVICES` note were deleted; the page module is loaded through a contained `loadTeamPage()` so a broken team page cannot take the workmate page with it.
fix.packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/team-page: `registerTeamSidebarTab(ctx, service)` now takes the ALREADY-RESOLVED service (never probes), and warns only when a caller passes a service without `registerTab`.
fix.packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/test/client-h: Models the race BY DEFAULT: `betterSidebar` is NOT in the registry while apply() runs, `ctx.inject` parks callbacks until every dependency is published (exactly like cordis), `provide()` wakes them, and `provideSidebar()`/`provideService()` publish afterwards. A probe-based implementation now fails the suite — proven by mutation (below).
fix.QA cases: agent-teams-sidebar.mjs rewired to the same injection semantics (the service is provided AFTER the client applies); web-client-adapt.mjs self-test pins `ctx.inject(['betterSidebar']` and forbids `serviceAvailable(`; workmate-library.mjs pins the injection and scans the mpd SOURCE (not the artifact, which carries the adopted bundle's own dormant `shell.overlay` registration).
fix.docs: docs/architecture.md section 7 (+ zh-CN) gained 'The other half of the rule — and the bug that hid behind it'; AGENTS.md gained a troubleshooting row naming the trap and forbidding both wrong fixes.

howToSeeIt: Refresh the page (the client bundle rev is a content hash, so a plain refresh picks up the new bytes).
Click the sidebar toggle (top-right) — the better-sidebar panel starts COLLAPSED; that default belongs to the sidebar plugin, not to this bundle.
Click `+` in the tab strip: the menu now ends with `🐳 AgentTeams` and `🤖 Workmates`.
The AgentTeams tab auto-opens by itself once when a NEW team appears in the conversation (plugin setting autoOpenOnTeamActivity, default ON).
